rows.what: Standing takedown shot lands; Grapple.takedown_resolve returns success and the seat moves to the returned ground seat (half or guard).
Cinch throw lands; Grapple.takedown_resolve from clinch returns success and the seat moves to the returned ground seat.
Top-man position advance on the ground (pass to mount, side to mount, mount to back); already on the floor, seat changes within ground stance.
Bottom man sweeps from half guard; reverses to top in guard, stance stays ground.
Bottom man escapes from side/mount/back to full guard; stance stays ground, top unchanged.
Top man in mount or back held long enough with a low action roll opens a submission attempt; no ruleset check gates it.
Open submission advances to finished; GrappleResolve.submission_advance returns finished true and the bout stops.

Grapple technique palette is built from the ruleset's discipline_tags via FightMoves.grapple_arsenal; muay_thai's tags (muay_thai, boxing, clinch) carry takedown and throw nodes that feed the ground path.
